**What you are trying to do**
The situation, not the feature. It is often solvable a way neither of us has
thought of yet.

**What you would expect to happen**

**What it would not be able to do**
Worth a line, because it decides whether this can be built honestly. A feature
whose name promises more than it delivers will be declined however useful the
rest of it is — see the honesty rule in CONTRIBUTING.md.
